column4: The essay constructs a theological interpretation of God, revelation and moral transformation. This is derived religious argument, not merely descriptive biblical history, so revised V5 remains applicable.

V1 remains: documented drug use is made to explain military success and Hitler's decisions beyond the evidence identified by the prior historian's review. The causal leap, not the pharmacological subject, determines the veto.

The book explicitly advances antiracist action in art institutions through its selected controversies. This declared civil-activist intervention remains V5, independently of the accuracy of individual cases.

The literary-historical essay criticizes communist apologetics. Such critical political argument is not automatically an explicit ideological manifesto; the earlier record establishes opposition, not a distinct activist declaration or serious V1–V4 finding.

The work explicitly promotes one feminist political doctrine against another as its organizing intervention. That declared ideological program remains V5; the decision does not presume all factual criticism is invalid.

Conditional on the retained David Talbot identification, V1 remains for unsupported documentary inferences central to the assassination suspicion. The prior critical exchange and favorable reception are both retained; identity remains qualified.

The work is an explicit political polemic against the professional-managerial class and its ideological practices. The declared class-political intervention meets V5; modest institutional observations remain counterfactual.

The work expressly advocates decolonial sovereignty as a liberation project. The retained evidence supports an explicit political-ideological purpose, beyond simply analyzing Palestine and Israel; V5 remains.

V1 remains on page-referenced criticism of sweeping medieval generalizations from hostile and literary anecdotes. Confidence stays moderate because the inspected critic is not a specialist and the specialist review was only bibliographically verified.

The personal wilderness essays oppose industrial tourism and defend a way of inhabiting landscapes. That environmental preference is allowed under revised V5 unless a distinct explicit activism declaration is established; the earlier broad advocacy basis is insufficient.

V3 remains: the principal value is personal testimony about family, identity and bereavement. The reviewed scope still does not establish a developed transferable explanatory model, independent of its literary merits.

V1 remains on the prior archival investigation of altered case narratives. Those changes affect the evidential basis of the central clinical stories; revised H2 and V5 do not repair that separate reliability issue.

The work explicitly advances an Indigenous ethical-political doctrine against colonial exploitation. This declared ideological purpose supports revised V5; cultural provenance alone is not the reason.
The book explicitly calls readers to political action against alleged authoritarian change in the United States. It is a civic manifesto under revised V5, not merely historical comparison.
The participant memoir expressly advances and defends a revolutionary political movement. That declared activist purpose remains V5; the judgment does not decide contested criminal allegations.

V1 remains: evidence of psychoactive substances in some ancient contexts does not establish the central continuous religious-origin hypothesis. The prior specialist critique targets that historical bridge, not the study of religion itself.

V1 remains on primary anthropological criticism of the central effortless-running and health portrait of the Tarahumara. Narrative and physiology retain credit but do not repair the unsupported general causal promise.

V1 remains: the prior specialist commentary identifies selective evidence and treatment-causation overreach. This is a substantive criticism with moderate confidence, not a claim that the field rejects every observation.

The explanatory chapters explicitly seek antiracist action and changes in readers' conduct. This declared civil-activist purpose meets revised V5; mixed discussion form is not automatically a technical manual under H2.
The work advances a spiritual account of money and a declared ecological-economic transformation through gift exchange and commons. The combined religious and explicit activist purpose remains V5.

The book offers an environmental philosophy of living and understanding. Revised V5 expressly permits visions; the existing evidence does not establish that this philosophical argument is an explicit declaration of activism.

V1 remains: retrospective psychiatric diagnoses of selected successful leaders do not establish that mood disorders cause superior crisis leadership. The prior assessment identifies selection and counterexample problems independent of the revised gates.

V1 remains: the narrative is presented as firsthand nonfiction despite material factual and attribution disputes. Retain that classification rather than relabel it fiction without resolving the genre dispute.

V3 remains: the river journey preserves local stories, landscape and personal memory without much developed transferable explanation. The decision concerns payload, not environmental preference or literary quality.

V3 remains: the childhood memoir's principal contribution is particular family and small-town experience. The reviewed evidence does not establish a substantial reusable explanatory account after those details are removed.
V3 remains: domestic anecdotes and family observation dominate the memoir, with little sustained mechanism or general model. Its comic and literary merits remain in the counterfactual score.
V3 remains: the collection's developed content chiefly portrays particular New Yorkers and locations. The reviewed scope supplies little general causal explanation beyond those documentary portraits.
V3 remains: the local sporting narrative does not establish enough transferable mechanism beyond particular participants and events. The hard exclusions do not apply merely because it is about sport.
V3 remains: the memoir centers on personal relationships, illness and loss. The available assessment does not establish a developed general mechanism beyond those individual episodes.

V1 remains: the documented bodily-effects and risk framing confuses materially different virus hazards. Prior CDC evidence about Reston supplies a concrete check separate from thematic dislike of disease.
V1 remains: material documentary challenges undermine the central founding and kidnapping narratives. Revised H2 and V5 do not repair those factual claims presented as nonfiction.

V1 remains: the literacy-to-hemisphere-to-patriarchy chain turns broad associations into civilizational causation without isolating competing causes. Medical credentials do not validate that central inference.
V1 remains because the prior detailed critique and author response leave central health-risk overstatements unresolved. The rule change supplies no new evidence that repairs those claims.

The Corbett biography is explicitly a faith-centered missionary account with spiritual authority and miracle narratives. That derived religious teaching purpose remains V5; the finding is specific to this identified biography.

The essays explicitly defend Objectivist political doctrine against rival cultural and environmental programs. V5 remains, alongside the prior separately assessed V2 concern about allegiance-dependent treatment.

The participant account explains and defends a protest and prosecution. Describing an activist episode does not itself make the book an explicit declaration of activism; the earlier broad purpose rationale is insufficient under revised V5.
V3 remains: celebrity recollection, family experience and illness are the core payload. The reviewed account supplies little developed transferable explanation beyond those personal episodes.
The essays explicitly articulate a revolutionary racial-political worldview. That declared ideological purpose meets revised V5 independently of their personal testimony.
V1 remains: cited documentary records conflict with the claimed firsthand escape narrative. Presentation as nonfiction does not justify silently reclassifying it as a novel.

V1 remains: strong stress-to-attention-disorder and reversal claims are not adequately identified, and retained genetic evidence challenges dismissal of inherited causation. Environmental influence itself is not denied.
V1 remains because speculative associations do not establish the central evolutionary role assigned to psychoactive experience. Cultural narrative and analogies retain their prior limited credit.

V1 remains on archaeological criticism of sound-alike place names and rejection of Dorset evidence in the migration history. Labeling elements speculative does not repair invalid historical inference.
V3 remains: the regional travel and personal comic memoir chiefly provides a literary experience. The reviewed scope lacks a developed reusable model beyond particular encounters.

V3 remains: royal portraits chiefly preserve personalities and succession detail, with insufficient transferable institutional explanation. The single-nation subject is a separate deduction rather than the veto itself.
V3 remains: local trails, runners and regional memories provide the main documentary value. Little developed mechanism survives removal of those specifics in the reviewed scope.

V3 remains: the athletic recovery memoir chiefly supplies personal experience and inspiration. The assessed material does not establish a substantial transferable model beyond the individual's trajectory.

V1 remains: the strong carbohydrate-insulin causal account lacks support in its required form from cited controlled metabolic evidence. This does not deny that a restricted diet can help particular people.
The central teaching is spiritual awakening and liberation from ego, a derived religious-spiritual text under V5. Prior independent V1 concerns are retained rather than cured by the rule revision.
The discourses directly teach awakening and ultimate reality. This is derived religious-spiritual teaching under V5; the absence of a technical exercise sequence keeps it outside H2.
The memoir explicitly introduces a religious worldview and presents supernatural claims as knowledge. V5 and prior V1 remain; its narrative form passes H2.

The cases support an anticapitalist social diagnosis and proposed alternative. Revised V5 does not automatically exclude a political inclination; the prior record lacks a distinct explicit manifesto or independent serious causal-veto finding.
V3 remains: the addiction diary is mainly personal and celebrity testimony. The reviewed material does not develop enough reusable explanation beyond those individual experiences.
V3 remains: the life story chiefly concerns music celebrity, relationships and addiction. Its personal lessons do not form a sustained transferable intellectual model in the reviewed scope.

Under the retained qualified identification as 1 Enoch, this is a primary religious-apocalyptic text and directly meets V5. The unresolved distinction from 2 or 3 Enoch remains explicit; conditional prior V1 is not strengthened.
The autobiography expressly conveys religious and spiritual teaching as a central purpose. This derived religious argument remains V5, rather than a veto based simply on celebrity status.
The work explicitly calls for collective ecological and social action, supported by spiritual renewal. That declared activist program remains V5; personal narrative does not remove it.
Miraculous guidance and spiritual transformation are organizing claims of the memoir. Derived religious purpose and prior unsupported-supernatural V1 remain independent of revised H2.

V3 remains: the music-celebrity memoir is dominated by individual episodes and addiction experience. The reviewed account offers too little sustained transferable explanation to pass this separate gate.

V1 remains: the prior location-by-location audit finds serious errors in places presented as directly observed. This undermines the central reporting claim without proving every person's account invented.
The central aim is spiritual transformation and awakening. Revised V5 retains derived religious teaching; prior V1 concerns about asserted knowledge remain separately recorded.

V1 remains for central biological claims extending beyond their evidence. The spiritual transformation doctrine also remains a V5 ground; revised wording does not establish the asserted biological mechanism.
V3 remains: the principal payload is testimony about an individual childhood and survival. The reviewed account does not establish a developed general causal model beyond that experience.

The nominated medieval narrative constructs a Christian universal and national-origin account. It is a religious primary text under V5, not a modern novel; scholarly apparatus must not be confused with the nominated narrative.

V1 remains: the central claimed contradiction in relativity compares clock rates defined by different event pairs and simultaneity conventions. Revised H2 admits the argumentative book but does not validate that error.

V1 remains: contested myth readings are treated as evidence for an actual civilizing group and Eden history while archaeological substantiation is still sought. The central historical bridge is not established.

The prior V1 concern about the civilizational causal narrative remains independent of V5. The explicitly spiritual and ecological transformation program also retains a V5 basis; broad synthesis does not repair the claims.

V1 remains: an archive of the author's research does not repair mistranslations and the unsupported ancient-astronaut premise. Notebooks document intellectual history, not the asserted ancient history.

V3 remains: the desert writing chiefly preserves local history, landscape and personal reflection. The reviewed scope does not establish substantial transferable explanation after those particulars are removed.

Prior V1 concerning spiritual self-healing claims remains independently relevant. The central spiritual-transformation teaching also meets revised V5; the memoir is not principally a yoga procedure manual.
V1 remains: the ancient-astronaut account depends on mistranslated Mesopotamian terms and unsupported astronomical readings. Source-based Nibiru criticism affects the foundation of the argument.
V1 remains for the nominated series' unsupported textual and astronomical reconstruction. Repetition across volumes does not supply independent evidence for its ancient-astronaut premise.
V1 remains for the unvalidated consciousness hierarchy and purported tests of truth. Its explicit spiritual doctrine also directly meets revised V5.
V1 remains: timing and institutional association do not establish alleged assassin-program recruitment and control. That unsupported causal link is central to the nonfiction thesis.
Explicit racial hatred, dehumanization and political manifesto directly meet revised V5. Prior V1 and V2 remain independently supported by the governing conspiracy and racial-allegiance argument.
The prior high-confidence V1 finding on the tax-ratification claim remains decisive. Its explicit tax-resistance campaign also remains V5; revised wording does not cure the legal-historical error.

The reported supply-chain history explains logistics, corporate incentives and fragility. Recommendations for institutional reform are allowed under revised V5; the earlier veto treated them as activism without a distinct explicit declaration.

Case histories explain innovation through experimentation, exchange and institutions. Institutional freedom is an allowed policy inclination, not sufficient evidence of an explicit ideological manifesto; selection limits stay in the score.

The publisher's own description explicitly presents this work as a manifesto on the state of American work, and its central program redirects institutions toward maintenance. This primary self-description meets the literal explicit-manifesto branch of revised V5.

The engineering narrative explains shared utilities and social constraints. Equitable and sustainable infrastructure is a proposed vision, expressly allowed by revised V5; the previous broad environmental/civic advocacy rationale no longer supports a veto.

V3 remains: the literary travelogue mainly preserves personal observation of America. The reviewed material offers too little developed transferable mechanism; reconstruction concerns remain scoring limits without an invented V1.

V3 remains: athletic competition, identity and relationships dominate; generic persistence and coaching anecdotes do not form a developed reusable model. Sports subject matter alone is not the veto or a thematic deduction.

The political memoir recounts reform and civil-rights work and explains institutions. Participant policy commitments are not automatically an explicit activist declaration under revised V5; the earlier broad purpose test is insufficient.
V3 remains: childhood, relationships and artistic celebrity dominate. The retained scope does not develop a transferable account of production or institutions after personal detail is removed.
V3 remains: the family memoir chiefly offers intimate testimony about work, poverty and survival. A sustained general explanatory mechanism is not established by the reviewed evidence.
V3 remains: family, identity and individual public experience dominate over sustained institutional explanation. The finding concerns payload, not political authorship or ideological disagreement.

V3 remains: personal identity, performance and comic recollection provide the main value. Craft observations survive, but the reviewed account does not develop enough transferable explanatory structure.
V1 remains: inconsistent witness memories do not supply direct evidence for the alleged body-alteration operation. The prior contemporary account identifies that material evidential gap.
V3 remains: the gift collection chiefly contains motivational quotations without a sustained explanatory argument. Scattered prescriptions do not make it a technical manual under revised H2.

The publisher presents a military and political memoir organized around leadership, service, courage and gratitude. Its favorable self-portrait does not establish an explicit partisan manifesto or activism declaration; revised V5 permits this political inclination. The prior broad positioning rationale is insufficient.

The illness memoir questions providence and prosperity theology through personal experience. Religious reflection does not automatically make a memoir a base or derived religious teaching text; the older broad religious-purpose finding is insufficient.

The joint memoir narrates community organization and social enterprise. Recounting an activist project is not itself a declaration of activism; revised V5 permits its social vision while founder-testimony limits remain.
V3 remains: the celebrity memoir's personal signs and motivational maxims do not become a sustained general mechanism. Revised eligibility and activism gates do not address that payload problem.
The publisher explicitly presents the biography as an entreaty for women's-rights action. This declared civil-activist purpose remains V5 beyond simply depicting a social organizer.

The memoir argues about language, education and assimilation. Political interpretation of personal experience is allowed under revised V5; the earlier record lacks an explicit manifesto or serious independent ideological-capture finding.

V3 remains: the comic memoir centers on identity, disability and media experience, with general encouragement rather than a developed reusable model. Disability is not automatically treated as disease.

The autobiography recounts political organization, imprisonment and negotiation. A movement history by its participant is not automatically an explicit declaration of activism; revised V5 permits the political commitments of this institutional narrative.

The memoir integrates scientific institutions, secrecy, state power and dissent. Recounting civil-rights campaigns does not make a science memoir an explicit activist manifesto; V5 is withdrawn without treating the V3 biography exception as overriding another gate.

The selected life account incorporates explicit spiritual teaching, including the Seven Sermons, as a central framework. That derived religious purpose remains V5; unverifiable inner experience alone does not add definitive V1.

V3 remains: the adolescent memoir chiefly delivers individual and literary experience. Its reviewed scope lacks a developed transferable mechanism after particular relationships and events are removed.

The autobiography explicitly develops religious truth-seeking and nonviolent political doctrine as central teachings. It is more than a memoir mentioning faith or politics and remains a derived religious/ideological work under V5.
